item.text:
Research continuation completed as far as the read-only environment allowed. I performed targeted favorable, adverse, attribution, implementation, and contrary searches across all eight chapters, with strongest recoveries in 3B, 4B, 5B, 6B, and 7B.

Key recoveries:

- 7B: Bundestag records confirm that the proposed Cum-Ex investigation explicitly concerned Scholz’s role and his failure to recall meetings; the coalition rejected the committee on jurisdictional grounds. This establishes scrutiny and unresolved attribution, not personal criminal guilt. [Bundestag proposal](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-943600), [rejection](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-956820)

- 3B/4B: Berlin’s Higher Administrative Court upheld a 15 April 2023 ban on a pro-Palestinian demonstration, while Amnesty criticized the broader blanket-ban practice. This supplies both lawful-public-order and adverse-rights evidence, with low Scholz attribution because the decision was Berlin/Länder-level. [Court release](https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/oberverwaltungsgericht/presse/pressemitteilungen/2023/pressemitteilung.1313956.php), [Amnesty analysis](https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/eur23/7180/2023/en)

- 3B/4B: October 2023 reporting showed Berlin police broke up a banned rally, while other German cities permitted pro-Palestinian demonstrations or courts overturned bans—useful contrary evidence against a uniform national-repression claim. [DW report](https://amp.dw.com/en/berlin-police-break-up-banned-pro-palestinian-rally/a-67104373)

- 5B/6B: Destatis reported 5.9% inflation and only 0.1% real-wage growth in 2023, materially sharpening household-impact evidence. [Inflation](https://www.destatis.de/EN/Press/2024/01/PE24_020_611.html), [real wages](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Presse/Pressemitteilungen/2024/02/PD24_076_62321.html)

- 6B/8B: Destatis reports that Wohngeld recipients increased by roughly 80%, or 521,700 households, after Wohngeld-Plus. This is implementation/take-up evidence, while not proof of adequate housing outcomes. [Destatis Wohngeld data](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Gesellschaft-Umwelt/Soziales/Wohngeld/_inhalt.html)

- 1B: The prior continuation’s independent units remain usable: Bundestag F-35 funding, Bundestag expert warnings on escalation and AI, SIPRI analysis, and ICAN’s contrary assessment of nuclear sharing. These should be retained with their existing methodology mappings and new IDs.
